intro: All food is freshly cooked and prepared in The Alma’s continued Scores on the Doors 5-star rated kitchen. Lunch is available Monday to Friday, with stone-baked stuffed crust pizzas served through the week.
highlights: Bookings recommended at busy lunch times

menus.title: Lunch Menu
menus.text: Freshly cooked pub lunches, sandwiches, paninis, jacket potatoes, dirty chips, sides and desserts.

menus.title: Pizza Menu
menus.text: Stone-baked stuffed crust pizzas, including vegetarian and meat options.

menus.title: Event Buffet Menu
menus.text: Buffet options for private gatherings, wakes, meetings and celebrations.

menus.title: BBQ Event Menu
menus.text: Seasonal outdoor catering for suitable private events.
